extruder.hint: Load: bowden length fast, then the slow length. Unload: unload length plus the bowden tube.

filament.failed: The printer did not accept the command

macros.empty: No macros: add one with Edit.

macros.gcodeHint: One command per line; text after ; is a comment.
macros.confirmHint: For macros that move the head or change settings.
macros.restoreMessage: Your macros are replaced by the four examples.
macros.runDuringJob: A job is running: these commands are sent between the lines of the file.

leveling.locked: Leveling moves are locked while a job is running; babystepping stays available.
leveling.paperStep1: Home, then tap a point: the nozzle goes down to Z0.
leveling.paperStep2: Turn the knob of that corner until a sheet of paper drags slightly under the nozzle.
leveling.paperStep3: Go round all the points twice.
leveling.notRead: Tap Read to show the mesh stored in the printer.
leveling.noMesh: The printer has no mesh stored yet.
leveling.noLevelingHint: The firmware reports no bed leveling. Without a probe, use the paper test.
leveling.mblIntro: Measure each point of the mesh with a sheet of paper: the printer homes and goes to the first point.
leveling.mblMessage: The printer homes and moves to the first point (G29 S1). Keep a sheet of paper at hand.
leveling.mblFirst: The printer homes first, then stops over the first point. Lower the nozzle until the paper drags slightly.
leveling.mblAdjust: Lower or raise the nozzle until the paper drags slightly, then store the point.
leveling.mblCancelMessage: The points measured so far are not saved and the printer homes again.
leveling.autoIntro: The probe measures the bed: the printer homes first, then probes every point.
leveling.autoMessage: The printer homes and probes the bed (G28, G29). Heat the bed first for the most accurate mesh.
leveling.autoStarted: Probing… the mesh appears when it is done
leveling.noProbeHint: The firmware reports no probe and manual mesh leveling is off. Use the paper test, or enable "manual mesh" among the firmware capabilities in the settings if Marlin has MESH_BED_LEVELING.
leveling.babystepHint: Works while printing: fine-tune the first layer live. Farther = nozzle away from the bed.
leveling.babystepMissing: The firmware does not report babystepping (BABYSTEPPING in Marlin).
leveling.probeOffsetHint: More negative = nozzle closer to the bed. Save to keep it after a restart.
leveling.eepromHint: Mesh, Z offset and the other firmware settings are lost at a restart unless saved.
leveling.saveMessage: The current firmware settings (mesh, offsets, …) are stored permanently (M500).

system.cmd.restartMessage: OctoPrint and the printer connection are restarted; the screen reconnects by itself in about a minute.
system.cmd.restartSafeMessage: OctoPrint restarts without third-party plugins, for troubleshooting.
system.cmd.rebootMessage: The whole system restarts: OctoPrint and this screen come back in a minute or two.
system.cmd.shutdownMessage: Wait until the green LED of the Pi stops blinking before unplugging the power. To turn it on again, unplug and plug it back.
system.duringJob: A print is running and will be lost.
system.runMessage: This OctoPrint system command runs on the Raspberry Pi.
system.commandFailed: OctoPrint did not run the command
system.shuttingDown: The Raspberry Pi is shutting down. Unplug it only when the green LED stops blinking.
system.noShutdown: Reboot and shutdown appear once they are configured in OctoPrint (Settings → Server).
system.commandsError: Could not load the system commands of OctoPrint.
system.kioskMessage: The browser of the kiosk is restarted. Printing is not affected.
system.kioskFailed: The kiosk could not be restarted: reloading the page instead
settings.title: Settings
settings.clock24hHint: Otherwise 12 hours with AM/PM. The time zone is the Pi's.
settings.beepHint: Through the printer's buzzer (on the LCD).
settings.resetHint: Every setting back to a fresh install, presets, macros and power actions included. The API key is kept.
settings.resetMessage: Language, presets, macros, power actions, capabilities and every other setting go back to the defaults. This cannot be undone.
settings.saverHint: A big, simple view after a while without touches.
settings.screenOffEnabled: Turn the screen off when idle
settings.screenOffHint: Only while nothing is printing; a touch turns it back on.
settings.resolutionHint: The dashboard is made for 1024 × 600. Current: {current}.
settings.resolutionKeepMessage: If you do not answer, the previous one comes back in {seconds} seconds.
settings.confirmAboveHint: A higher target needs one more tap to confirm.
settings.maxTempHint: The NumPad accepts nothing above this. Lower limits of the OctoPrint printer profile win.
settings.webcamHint: Empty = the webcam configured in OctoPrint. Now in use:
caps.title: Firmware capabilities
caps.intro: Auto uses what the firmware reports (M115). Force On/Off when the report is wrong or the feature is not reported.
caps.manualOnly: Not reported by the firmware: set it by hand
objects.title: Objects on the bed
objects.hint: Tap an object to stop printing it: the others go on.
objects.confirmMessage: It will not be printed any more, the other objects go on. This cannot be undone.
objects.last: It is the last object left: to end the print use Stop.
objects.needsUpload: This file was uploaded before the Cancel Objects plugin was installed: upload it again to remove objects from its prints.

power.empty: No buttons yet: add lights or other actions with Edit.
power.psuStatusBar: Power button in the status bar
power.noPsu: PSU Control is not installed in OctoPrint: its switch appears here when it is.
actions.title: Custom actions
actions.intro: Buttons that send G-code, run an OctoPrint system command or call a plugin: lights, fans, relays…
actions.name: Name
actions.gcodeHint: One command per line, e.g. M355 S1 for the case light.
actions.systemHint: Commands defined in OctoPrint (Settings → Server, or plugins).
actions.pluginHint: Sent as POST /api/plugin/<plugin> with {"command": …} plus these fields.
actions.confirmHint: G-code actions always ask while printing.
actions.statusBarHint: Up to {max} buttons, always in reach.

actions.error.duplicate: An action with this name already exists.
actions.error.gcode: Enter at least one G-code command.

apikey.title: OctoPrint API key
apikey.hint: Create a key in OctoPrint (Settings → Application Keys) and type it here. It stays in the agent, never in the browser.
apikey.fromEnv: This key comes from the agent's environment: a new one works until the next restart.
apikey.savedNotPersistent: API key in use until the agent restarts: reconnecting…
apikey.error.format: That does not look like an API key (16-128 letters, digits, - or _).
apikey.error.rejected: OctoPrint rejected this key: nothing changed.
apikey.error.unreachable: OctoPrint is not reachable: the key could not be checked.
apikey.error.save: The key could not be saved.
